base_member_text: [L40] (MED/host-verification) The unconditional yes piped into pscp accepts an initial host-key prompt without identity verification.
audit_member_text: [L40] (MED/host-authentication) Piping an unconditional yes to pscp accepts an unverified host-key prompt instead of requiring a known server identity.

base_member_text: [L68,L85-L96] (LOW/empty-input) Missing configuration directories are silently skipped and an empty index is still uploaded when none exist.
audit_member_text: [L68,L81,L90-L96] (MED/publication-completeness) Missing configuration directories are silently skipped and the download index is still replaced, so incomplete or entirely absent build outputs can publish an incomplete or empty release page.

adversarial.rationale: The exists check has no failure branch, and index generation/upload follows the loops regardless of how many configurations exist. An in-memory execution of the actual function with all exists checks false produced an empty list and still called the upload path; no external completeness guard was found.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L37-L45] (LOW/resource-lifetime) Each put opens a null-output file without an explicit close, while the client close method does nothing.
audit_member_text: [L37-L41,L44-L45] (LOW/resource-lifecycle) Each upload opens a devnull stream without explicitly closing it, relying on interpreter cleanup rather than the client's no-op close method.

base_member_text: [L37-L41,L77-L83,L96] (MED/error-handling) Discarded transfer status and diagnostics allow failed uploads to appear successful and leave the published index pointing at absent artifacts.
audit_member_text: [L40-L41] (HIGH/upload-failure-propagation) The upload subprocess return code is ignored and both output streams are discarded, allowing failed binary transfers to be reported as finished and listed in the published index.

adversarial.rationale: The active client is the local SSHClient at L52, not the commented Paramiko implementation that could raise transfer errors. Its put method ignores a nonzero subprocess result, and an in-memory run with every transfer returning failure still generated eight binary links and the finished message.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L121-L125] (MED/archive-layout) Every archived file uses only its basename, flattening subdirectories and permitting duplicate member names that lose the original directory structure.
audit_member_text: [L119-L125] (MED/archive-layout) Every archive entry uses only fname, flattening nested directories and creating duplicate names or breaking relative-path dependencies.

adversarial.rationale: The complete archive helper recursively walks cpath but passes only fname as arcname at L125. The zip exclusion prevents self-inclusion but does not preserve directory prefixes, so two non-zip files with the same basename in different directories collide inside the archive.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L40-L41] (MED/shell-quoting) Unquoted interpolation of executable paths, credentials and transfer paths into a shell command breaks on spaces or shell metacharacters.
audit_member_text: [L38-L41] (HIGH/shell-command-construction) Executable paths, credentials, and transfer paths are interpolated unquoted into a shell command, so spaces or shell metacharacters can corrupt arguments or execute unintended commands.

adversarial.rationale: SSHClient.put assembles and executes an unquoted shell string at L38-L41, and connect merely stores the supplied strings. Neither the distribute caller nor the CLI sanitizes those values, so ordinary spaces and shell metacharacters affect command parsing.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L24-L28,L40] (MED/ignored-argument) The connection port is stored but never supplied to pscp, so a nondefault port is silently ignored.
audit_member_text: [L24-L26,L40] (MED/ignored-configuration) connect stores the requested port but put never passes it to pscp, so nondefault SSH ports are ignored.

adversarial.rationale: distribute forwards its port argument to connect at L54, but put constructs pscp arguments without either that stored value or a -P option. The CLI happens to use port 22, but the explicitly exposed nondefault-port function argument is ineffective.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L123-L124] (LOW/archive-contract) The advertised entire-directory archive excludes every ZIP file, including ZIP resources unrelated to the generated output archive.

audit_member_text: [L77] (LOW/path-contract) The binary destination is built by concatenating targetdir and 'bin/' without requiring or adding a trailing separator.
dispositions.rationale: span-refuted: Although L77 concatenates targetdir and 'bin/', the in-file entry point fixes targetdir to '/htdocs/xbeach/testbed/' at L150 and passes it unchanged at L164-L169. That trailing slash neutralizes the alleged malformed destination on the script's actual call path; a failure would require a different external caller.
